ctf.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CTF category cover for a dark personal blog, landscape 16:9.
Input images: Image 1 is the user's tree-and-lantern night wallpaper, the primary art-style reference. Image 2 is the user's rainy-window wallpaper, a secondary reference for restrained shading. These are references, not edit targets. Generate a new scene that belongs beside them visually.
Primary request: Match the actual drawing language of these references closely: a traditional 2D anime background still, crisp dark silhouettes, irregular hand-drawn contours, flat cel-like shadow shapes, restrained brushed shading inside those shapes, limited detail, and deep indigo night colours. Keep the image dark and graphic rather than glossy or photographic.
Scene: a quiet grassy hill beside a narrow river under an indigo night sky. A simple wooden footbridge leads toward the far bank. At the near bridge entrance on the right, a small weathered wooden post holds one plain muted-blue cloth pennant and one small hanging lantern. The pennant quietly suggests a CTF flag. Low tree branches frame the upper right, distant trees are flat layered shapes, a few stars occupy the open left sky.
Composition: wide, still, uncluttered. The tiny flag and warm lantern sit around the right third above the bottom quarter. Leave the bottom quarter as simple dark grass and water so a title wave can overlay it later. Make the flag readable at thumbnail size without exaggerating it.
Palette: very dark navy, muted blue-purple, a little desaturated moss, one pale warm lantern light. Low contrast except for the lantern. The reference's calm late-night feeling is essential.
Constraints: full-bleed illustration, no paper border, no text, no logos or watermarks. No hackers, cyberpunk, circuitry or UI. Avoid gouache-paper texture, visible coarse dry-brush strokes, pastel watercolour, polished fantasy concept art, glossy 3D, photographic depth of field, lens effects, dramatic bloom, excessive stars, tiny repeated decorative details, hyper-detailed foliage and saturated magical lighting.

machines.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Machines category cover for a dark personal blog, landscape 16:9.
Input images: Image 1 is the user's rainy-window night wallpaper, the primary art-style and composition reference. Image 2 is the user's tree-and-lantern night wallpaper, a secondary reference for silhouettes and restrained colour. These are references, not edit targets. Generate a new scene that belongs beside them visually.
Primary request: Match the actual drawing language of these references closely: a traditional 2D anime background still, crisp dark silhouettes, slightly irregular hand-drawn contours, flat cel-like shadows, restrained brushed shading within large shapes, simple distant buildings and a deep indigo palette. Preserve the reference's quiet graphic simplicity.
Scene: looking across a quiet desk toward a broad rain-streaked window at night. A muted blue-purple city skyline is visible outside in simple layered rectangular shapes with sparse small pale windows. A small dark cat sits on the sill to the left of centre. On the right of the desk is one simple compact cream desktop monitor with a dark blue blank screen, keyboard hinted with a few lines, and a desk lamp casting a small soft pool of warm light. The computer quietly suggests machine labs, without any hacking imagery.
Composition: wide and calm, window occupies most of the scene. Use a few large shapes, no crowded room or shelves. Keep the recognizable monitor around the right third, comfortably above the bottom quarter. Leave the bottom quarter mainly as dark simple desk shadow for a title wave overlay.
Palette: very dark navy, muted indigo and blue-purple, grey-brown window frame, desaturated cream monitor, one pale warm lamp highlight. Low contrast and little glow.
Constraints: full-bleed illustration, no paper border, no text, no logos or watermarks. No code, cyberpunk, circuitry or UI. Avoid gouache-paper texture, coarse dry-brush strokes, pastel watercolour, glossy 3D, photographic depth of field, lens effects, dramatic bloom, decorative clutter, excessively detailed city lights and shiny render-like surfaces. This should look like a restrained hand-drawn night-anime background, not a polished digital concept painting.
